definitions.explanation: The third day of the week in the Japanese calendar (which starts on Sunday). Short form of {火曜日|かようび}. Used in scheduling, calendars, and everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: {火曜|かよう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧です。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧{火曜|かよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The meeting is held every Tuesday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{火曜|かよう}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit the report by next Tuesday.

notes:
USAGE:
Short form of ⟦{火曜日|かようび}→火曜日：00640_kayoubi⟧. Both are common; {火曜|かよう} is slightly more concise and often seen in written schedules. The name comes from ⟦{火星|かせい}→火星：13412_kasei⟧ (Mars), following the East Asian system of naming days after celestial bodies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧{火曜|かよう}: every Tuesday
- {火曜|かよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧: Tuesday night
- ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{火曜|かよう}: next Tuesday
- {火曜|かよう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{木曜|もくよう}→木曜：03163_mokuyou⟧: Tuesday and Thursday
